english_reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

transcript: Todos los sustantivos, así como el vocablo Sie para significar 'usted', llevan siempre su letra inicial mayúscula, aunque estén ubicados en el medio de la oración.
english_reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.

transcript: Atleta integral, el tigre tiene la habilidad de trepar (pero no demasiado bien), nadar, dar extensos saltos y jalar cinco veces más fuerte que una persona robusta.
english_reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.

transcript: Mas, luego de quedar sin el wicket del capitán, India solo logró 36 carreras y 7 de sus wickets fueron derribados para finalizar las vueltas.
english_reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.

transcript: Se acoge a los niños en hogares de guarda por una amplia variedad de motivos, desde negligencia hasta abuso e, incluso, extorsión.
english_reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.

english_reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.

transcript: La Vía Láctea influeye en la galaxia de Sagitario del mismo modo en que la luna ejerce una fuerza de atracción sobre nuestro planeta y causa las mareas.
english_reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

transcript: Esto parece tener sentido, ya que en la Tierra no se percibe su movimiento, ¿cierto?
english_reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?

english_reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.

transcript: Nada puede verse más que el maravilloso cielo despejado y las numerosas montañas de los alrededores. Desde el interior de esta cueva, se puede ver u oír muy poco de este mundo.
english_reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.

transcript: Durante los cruceros por San Petersburgo también se pasa tiempo en la ciudad. Se exime a quienes desembarcan de los requerimientos de visado (consulte términos).
english_reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).

transcript: Las plantas generan el oxígeno que las personas respiran y absorben el dióxido de carbono que ellas exhalan (que despiden).
english_reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).

transcript: La cúpula central de la iglesia había permanecido en Roma por más de un milenio y esta concentración de poder y dinero hizo que muchos se preguntaran si este principio se estaba respetando.
english_reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.

transcript: La vall de Cochamó: la destinació d'escalada més destacada de Xile, també anomenada la Yosemite d'Amèrica del Sud, compta amb moltes parets de granit de grans dimensions i penya-segats.
english_reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.

transcript: Aneu amb compte de no permetre que el teixit s'escalfi en excés (es podria encongir o, en casos extrems, socarrar).
english_reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).

transcript: Avui, els únics insectes que no poden plegar les ales són l'espiadimonis i l'efímera.
english_reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.

transcript: En conseqüència, el treball conjunt d'una organització per a superar una adversitat pot portar a un procés innovador per a respondre a la necessitat del client.
english_reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.

transcript: Europa és un continent relativament petit però amb molts països independents. En circumstàncies normals, viatjar entre diversos països implicaria haver de fer moltes sol·licituds de visat i controls de passaport.
english_reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.

transcript: Segons l'agència nuclear del Japó, a la planta s'han identificat cesi i iode radioactius.

english_reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.

english_reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.

english_reference: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.

transcript: Així, sembla que la notació es va afegir simplement com una etiqueta.
english_reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.

transcript: Si no esteu acostumats a conduir per carreteres rurals, aneu amb compte: hi predominen els pendents pronunciats, els trams estrets i les corbes tancades.
english_reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.

transcript: Els viatgers lligats a països amb forta taxació de vegades poden estalviar-se una quantitat de diners considerable, sobretot en productes com ara begudes alcohòliques i tabac.
english_reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.

transcript: Els corrents de ressaca són el flux que torna després que les ones xoquin amb la platja, sovint a un escull o similars.
english_reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
